notes.title: Jumps Hub World Update
notes.content:
Jumps receives a major update after many years! This update replaces the old Level Select Menu system with a new 3D Hub World which you can explore and find secrets in - Less UI, more Jumping! 

With so many quality improvements, bug fixes and more updates on the way: including a Speedrun Mode, Level Editor and Multiplayer, the future of Jumps has never looked so bright!

[b]More info from the Developer:[/b]
For the past 10 months I have been working on this update, I created this game when I was 16 and I am now 23. This is the only game I've ever released commercially. I used Unity as my game engine since I was 14 years old, moving on from GameMaker: Studio. I've had many failed attempts at making new games and I ended up returning to the only game I ever finished to show it some love.

I'm thinking of this update as setting up better foundations for the game, it may not seem like a lot but I think the hub world is a massive improvement over the old level select menu system, and I've fixed a bunch of bugs and code issues that have been plaguing Jumps since its release. I've essentially rebuilt over half the game with this update and now its going to be much easier to update the game moving forward.

I'm proud of 16 year old me for making this game and I'm proud of myself now at 23 for the work I've done to freshen this game up.

I'm testing the game on mobile atm too so you might see Jumps coming to iOS and Android soon.

I hope you enjoy the update!
Soon enough I shall return to add the Speedrun mode, an Endless procedural mode, and then in the future I want to finally finish the Level Editor update and finish adding Mutliplayer to Jumps so you can race your friends. But until then, I've got a couple other projects I want to work on: GOPOGO & Sound Gardener (a VR music game).

notes.title: A New Chapter for Jumps
notes.content:
Hello Dedicated Jumpers,

Hope this message lands you into a world of excitement. I know it's been quite a leap since we last convened in our cherished jumping universe, Jumps. Despite the silence that echoed around our game, I’ve always believed in the magic of the jump that made Jumps a special leap of joy for us all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27905239/941cd7276a7765a47ac7aac0f157f059dad1d9f6.png[/img]

As the developer of Jumps, I'm hopping with joy to announce an exciting jumpstart that's set to propel our beloved game back into action. I'm adding a brand new world to Jumps!

To keep our jumping community bouncing with energy, I've also set up a Discord server. This platform will be our trampoline for reconnection, discussions, and shared jumping excitement as we discover this new world together. Whether you're an experienced jumper or just starting your jumping journey, you're invited to join our community and help us bounce back the magic of Jumps.

Discord link: https://discord.gg/Yy6BQX2MDy

Here, we will leap into regular game updates, behind-the-scenes glimpses, bounce around your suggestions and feedback, and foster a jumping community of dedicated Jumpers. We can chat, share our jumping stories, and celebrate every high jump and nimble manoeuvre.

I firmly believe that a game like Jumps is not just about the jumping experiences it offers, but also the community that jumps around it. I am jumping with excitement for this new chapter for Jumps and the bouncing community revival we're about to embark upon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27905239/d0b51c09911c319823644a78e691aa7beff0418e.png[/img]

Thank you for your jumping enthusiasm, patience, and unwavering belief in Jumps. Here’s to a new leap, more thrilling jumps, and a stronger, jumping community!

Let's keep jumping!

Timothy aka Freug
Game Developer of Jumps

notes.title: Problem with Mac version
notes.content:
All Mac OS users:

Jumps was experiencing crashes on Mac when launching the game. I've temporarily fixed this by disabling Post Processing completely, which means no nice graphics (Anti-aliasing, bloom, etc.) until I can figure out a solution.

I'm terribly sorry for the inconvenience, I will try to have this fixed as soon as possible.

Thanks!
-Timothy

notes.title: Small quality update - Rebindable keys, Random level mode, bug fixes
notes.content:

- Added random level mode that unlocks when you complete world 6 (Steampunk).
- Rebindable keys in launcher actually work now (Thank you Anda and Intelligence).
- The first level of each world now stays unlocked when you reset your times.
- Fixed lava not killing the player on Level 10 of the desert world (Thank you r00ster).
- Fixed cacti and spiked islands (Steampunk) not killing the player.
- When you unlock a new world you are now notified at the end of the level, ie: "Snow world unlocked!".
- Player now moves the same speed backwards as forwards.

notes.title: Event - Beat the world record and win 5 Jumps keys!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The [url="http://www.speedrun.com/Jumps"]Jumps speedrun[/url] page hasn't really been given much love so I've decided to do an event, to build a community and kick start the competition on the speedrun.com page.

For the next 2 weeks, if you hold the WR on the [url="http://www.speedrun.com/Jumps"]speedrun.com page[/url], you will be rewarded with 5 steam keys for the game, which you can give to your friends or do whatever you want with them.

Good luck! I hope to see lots of entries.

Join the Jumps community [url=https://discord.gg/XwSvJ9Bl]Discord[/url] to discuss strategies and mechanics. 
Submit your run on the [url="http://www.speedrun.com/Jumps"]speedrun.com page[/url].

notes.title: Update (v1.2) - Bugs fixes, Trampoline SFX, Slight level changes
notes.content:
Hello!

This update fixes a bunch of problems major and minor, and adjusts a few things:
- Fixed times not adding up correctly.
- Adjusted world unlock times as some people were finding it too difficult or "grindy".
- Added Trampoline "Boing" sound effect.
- Adjusted bridge on W1L10 to stop making the player do that annoying bounce.
- Super slight level changes.

Jumps has a Speedrun.com [www.speedrun.com] page, record yourself speedrunning the game, and submit it there to compete for ultimate bragging rights! ;)

If you have any issues or bugs, contact me here: kiwiforgegames@gmail.com

Thanks everyone for playing!
-Timothy
